{{Quotation|game|
Far from any human civilizations, Maguuma Stade is thought to have been a meeting place for the [[druid]]s who long inhabited this part of the jungle. The elements and grasping vines have all but erased the evidence that anyone was ever here.
}}

This tiny outpost, hidden in the southern reaches of [[Tangle Root]], is easy to miss when following the storyline between [[Aurora Glade]] and [[Riverside Province]], as players are directed quickly through the jungle outside the [[Henge of Denravi]] to points eastward.

==Notes==
*Complete exploration of this outpost adds less than 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] Title.
*This is easily the least known or visited outpost in all of Prophecies since many people skip the Maguuma Jungle stage of the storyline, and those who don't usually go through without noticing this outpost.
{{Anomaly|The henchmen here show up as neutral NPCs (lime triangle) on the compass rather than their normal ally (green circle) appearance.}}
